title: Recommendation to accept a gift of $4,000 for library materials for the Donald Bruce Kaufman Brentwood Branch Library received from the Friends of the Donald Bruce Kaufman Brentwood Branch Library. Discussion Items
text:
[Board of Library Commissioners, Exhibit B]
Recommendation to accept a gift of $4,000 for library materials for the Donald Bruce Kaufman Brentwood Branch Library received from the Friends of the Donald Bruce Kaufman Brentwood Branch Library. Discussion Items
summary: The Board of Library Commissioners will consider accepting a $4,000 gift from the Friends group for library materials at the Donald Bruce Kaufman Brentwood Branch Library.
